title: Have A Nice Day — EN/AR/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar trilingual storytelling 108bpm walking bass brushed drums warm baritone vocal English Arabic French language learning character portrait
lyrics:
[Intro - warm acoustic blues, unhurried]
My dad is a big man
A bricklayer
Not a complicated man
But a precise one

[Verse 1 - English]
Train station. Man walks up.
Got a smoke? No.
How about you get us both one?
Man comes back with two cigarettes.
Dad takes it, snaps it, says I don't smoke.
Got a dollar? Yes, sure do.
Have a nice day.
Gets on the train.

On the train. Ticket inspector.
Walks past the ones without tickets.
Straight to Dad. Ticket please.
Check them first.
Sir, we don't want a problem.
Check them first.
Inspector checks. Lot of swearing. No tickets. Off the train.
I will get you. OK.
Here's my ticket.
First and only time on a train in Australia.

[Verse 2 - العربية Arabic]
أبي رجل كبير، بنّاء
(My dad is a big man, a bricklayer)
عند محطة القطار، رجل اقترب منه
(At the train station, a man approached him)
هل معك سيجارة؟ لا
(Got a smoke? No)
ماذا لو اشتريت لنا اثنتين؟
(How about you get us both one?)
أبي كسرها وقال لا أدخّن
(Dad snapped it and said I don't smoke)
هل معك دولار؟ نعم، بالتأكيد
(Got a dollar? Yes, sure do)
استمتع بيومك
(Have a nice day)
في القطار — المفتش جاء مباشرة إلى أبي
(On the train — inspector came straight to Dad)
تحقق منهم أولاً — تحقق منهم أولاً
(Check them first — check them first)
لا تذاكر — خارج القطار
(No tickets — off the train)
هنا تذكرتي
(Here is my ticket)

[Chorus - Français]
C'est juste qui il est
(That's just who he is)
Pas d'argument, pas d'explication
(No argument, no explanation)
C'est juste qui il est
(That's just who he is)
Il n'a pas besoin de le dire deux fois
(He doesn't need to tell you twice)
Il dit ce qui est vrai
(He says what's true)
Il fait ce qui est juste
(He does what's right)
Et il monte dans le train
(And he gets on the train)
C'est juste qui il est
(That's just who he is)

[Bridge - all three]
He knew who had a ticket — يعرف من يملك تذكرة — Il savait qui avait un billet
And he knew who didn't — ومن لا يملك — Et qui n'en avait pas
And he knew which one he was — ويعرف من هو — Et il savait qui il était
Have a nice day — استمتع بيومك — Bonne journée

[Outro]
Not a complicated man — ليس رجلاً معقداً — Pas un homme compliqué
But a precise one — لكنه دقيق — Mais un homme précis
Have a nice day — استمتع بيومك — Bonne journée
